question:
A product can be processed on any one of the four devices A, B, C, or D. The setup completion cost for each device when it is activated, the unit cost of production for the product, and the maximum processing capacity for each device are known as shown in Table 5-7. How can the total cost be minimized to produce 2000 units of the product? Try to establish a mathematical model.
Table 5-7
\begin{tabular}{c|c|c|c}
\hline Device & Setup Completion Cost (in yuan) & Production Cost (in yuan per unit) & Maximum Processing Capacity (units) \\\hline A & 1000 & 20 & 900 \
B & 920 & 24 & 1000 \
C & 800 & 16 & 1200 \
D & 700 & 28 & 1600 \
\hline
\end{tabular}

import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Problem: single product, four candidate devices A, B, C, D.
# Choose which devices to activate (pay a fixed setup cost) and how many
# units each activated device produces, so that the total of 2000 units is
# produced at minimum total cost (setup + production).
#
# Decision variables
#   y[j] in {0,1}   : 1 if device j is activated (setup cost paid), else 0
#   x[j] >= 0       : units produced on device j (continuous)
#
# Objective (minimize, in words)
#   total setup cost + total production cost
#       = sum_j setup[j]*y[j] + sum_j unitcost[j]*x[j]
#
# Constraints
#   (1) Demand:      sum_j x[j] == demand                       [produce 2000 units]
#   (2) Capacity:    x[j] <= cap[j] * y[j]  for each device j   [max processing capacity;
#                                                                also links x to y so that
#                                                                production is only possible
#                                                                on an activated device]
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DATA = {
    "devices": ["A", "B", "C", "D"],
    "setup": {"A": 1000, "B": 920, "C": 800, "D": 700},
    "unitcost": {"A": 20, "B": 24, "C": 16, "D": 28},
    "capacity": {"A": 900, "B": 1000, "C": 1200, "D": 1600},
    "demand": 2000,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Sets
    model.J = pyo.Set(initialize=d["devices"])

    # Decision variables
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.J, within=pyo.Binary)
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.J, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Objective: minimize total setup + production cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["setup"][j] * m.y[j] + d["unitcost"][j] * m.x[j]
                   for j in m.J)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Constraint (1): total production must equal demand
    def demand_rule(m):
        return sum(m.x[j] for j in m.J) == d["demand"]

    model.demand_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=demand_rule)

    # Constraint (2): capacity limit and activation linking
    def capacity_rule(m, j):
        return m.x[j] <= d["capacity"][j] * m.y[j]

    model.capacity_con = pyo.Constraint(model.J, rule=capacity_rule)

    return model
